meta.source_note: Titles and view counts transcribed from supplied screenshots or conversation. Performance figures are observations, not independently verified analytics. Channel baselines and subscriber counts are unknown unless stated. Ages are relative to when the screenshots were taken.
meta.evidence_status: No ordinary-performing controls are in this corpus yet, so no mechanism here can be rated above 'repeated examples'.

counterintuitive_causality.name: Counterintuitive causality
counterintuitive_causality.definition: An unexpected cause is assigned to a familiar outcome.
counterintuitive_causality.research_question: Do unexpected explanations of familiar problems outperform straightforward advice on comparable topics?

transformation_compression.name: Transformation compression
transformation_compression.definition: A large change is presented within a striking timeframe.
transformation_compression.research_question: Does compressing a large transformation into a short timeframe increase curiosity, and how does the audience respond to repeated versions of a similar concept?

exclusive_method.name: Exclusive method
exclusive_method.definition: A method is framed as uniquely effective or unusually powerful.
exclusive_method.research_question: Does a strong claim of exclusivity outperform a neutral instructional title when the subject and audience are comparable?

unconventional_mechanism.name: Unconventional mechanism
unconventional_mechanism.definition: The solution sounds surprising, forbidden, or contrary to expectations.
unconventional_mechanism.research_question: Does the unexpected mechanism generate more interest than the outcome alone?

emotional_diagnosis.name: Emotional diagnosis
emotional_diagnosis.definition: An internal experience receives a clear explanation or interpretation.
emotional_diagnosis.research_question: Do titles that articulate an experience viewers struggle to explain earn more attention than titles that merely name the topic?

universal_desire.name: Universal desire
universal_desire.definition: A broadly desirable outcome is promised.
universal_desire.research_question: Does a socially desirable outcome outperform a topic-led title when the audience and subject matter are comparable?

social_stakes.name: Social stakes
social_stakes.definition: Approval, rejection, respect, attraction, or status is placed at risk.
social_stakes.research_question: How does framing a social behaviour around negative consequences compare with framing it around positive rewards?

named_framework.name: Named framework
named_framework.definition: A compact rule, system, or method gives the subject a memorable structure.
named_framework.research_question: Does naming a compact framework increase perceived usefulness, memorability, or curiosity?

belief_reversal.name: Belief reversal
belief_reversal.research_question: Do titles that challenge an existing belief create stronger interest than titles that simply promise improvement?

attention_exchange.name: Attention exchange
attention_exchange.definition: A small investment is exchanged for a valuable outcome.
attention_exchange.research_question: Does explicitly framing the value exchange improve performance compared with promising the same outcome without specifying the return?

identity_contrast.name: Identity contrast
identity_contrast.definition: Two competing behaviours, identities, or states are placed in opposition.
identity_contrast.research_question: Does a contrast between two identities make an abstract improvement more concrete?
